Turns Out It Sells Commerce, and Even the AI Search Engines Disagree About It

In this issue

  • Building a store on Optimizely. The storefront and its content are theirs, without qualification.
  • The agents. Optimizely sells an agent platform with more than fifty prebuilt agents, no code orchestration, event and schedule triggers, and human approval gates.
  • What the machines say. I asked two AI search engines about Optimizely and got two different companies back.
  • Who it is for, and who it is not for. For, a marketing led enterprise that wants content, experimentation, and personalization from one company and will run commerce as an integration project.
  • Five of ten, on paper. My readiness score, and I will flag that this one is scored on paper.
